items.question: Does C# if() treat 0 as false?
items.answer: No. The condition must be bool. Convert or compare explicitly. That is a common JS-to-C# trap.
followUps: How do raw string literals help CSV fixtures?
items.sixtySeconds: if needs bool. Literals are typed. Raw strings since C# 11 for JSON/CSV.

items.question: What is new about ?. in C# 14?
items.answer: It can appear on the left of assignment or compound assignment. The right-hand side runs only if the receiver is not null. ++/-- still illegal on ?.
followUps: Does JS allow optional chaining on the left of = ?
items.sixtySeconds: C# 14: x?.P = e assigns only when x is non-null; e is skipped otherwise.

items.question: Why doesn’t a C# switch fall through?
items.answer: Implicit fall-through is a compile error. Stack labels or use goto case. Pattern switches are a different feature.
followUps: When do you pick foreach over for?
items.sixtySeconds: Must break/return/throw/goto case. foreach for sequences; goto case for explicit fall-through.

items.question: What does checked do? What about nameof(List<>)?
items.answer: checked throws on integral overflow instead of wrapping. nameof is a compile-time name; C# 14 allows unbound generics so nameof(List<>) is List. sizeof is for unmanaged value types.
followUps: Is default context checked or unchecked?
items.sixtySeconds: Default wrap; checked throws. nameof rename-safe; C# 14 unbound generics. sizeof not for objects.

items.question: What is #nullable compared to #if?
items.answer: #if removes code from compilation. #nullable toggles nullable analysis. The actual NRT rules are module 07. #: directives on file-based apps are SDK config, not preprocessor.
followUps: Where should DEBUG-only RabbitMQ dry-run live?
Why is #region not a design tool?
items.sixtySeconds: #if strips tokens. #nullable is a warning switch. Do not confuse with #: in file-based apps.
